name: io.iron-out/ux-benchmark
title: Iron/Out UX Score Benchmark
description: UX Score and Web Vitals (TTFB, FCP, LCP, INP, CLS) for any website, from real-user CrUX data.

tools.name: run_ux_benchmark
tools.description: Returns the Iron/Out UX Score (0 to 100) for one website, using real-user Chrome UX Report (CrUX) data from the last 28 days. The score is built on five Web Vitals: TTFB (10%), FCP (15%), LCP (25%), INP (25%) and CLS (25%). Use this when the user asks how fast or user-friendly a site is for real visitors. It does not run a lab test or Lighthouse and does not load the site. Sites with too little Chrome traffic have no CrUX data and return no score. If a monthly revenue band is given, it also estimates the revenue at stake. Returns a summary and a link to the full report.

url.description: Website or page to check, for example zalando.nl or https://www.example.com/. Use the shop domain visitors actually use (for example www2.hm.com).

monthlyRevenue.description: The site's monthly online revenue band. Only set this if the user said it. Never guess it.

language.description: Language of the linked report. Use nl when the user writes in Dutch.

tools.name: compare_sites
tools.description: Compares the Iron/Out UX Score of 2 to 5 websites side by side, using real-user Chrome UX Report (CrUX) data from the last 28 days (Web Vitals: TTFB, FCP, LCP, INP, CLS). Use this for competitor or sector comparisons. It runs no lab test or Lighthouse. Returns a ranking and a link to the full comparison.

urls.description: The websites to compare, for example ["zalando.nl", "wehkamp.nl"].

category.description: Sector label shown in the report, for example Electronics. It does not change the scores.

language.description: Language of the linked report. Use nl when the user writes in Dutch.
